name: postgres
description: Reads PostgreSQL tables: discovers schemas/columns from information_schema, snapshots tables with bounded cursor-incremental reads, and supports fixture-safe bounded row DML/truncate reverse ETL actions. CDC is a documented stub pending the gated pglogrepl dependency.

risk.write: high: bounded reverse ETL row DML/truncate only; no arbitrary SQL; requires plan, preview, explicit approval, and typed fields
risk.approval: reverse ETL writes require plan -> preview -> approval -> execute; truncate_table is destructive and requires confirm_phrase=truncate
